results.name: Multiple homonymous personal imports distinguish confirmation and failure; retry does not duplicate successes
Later addition, reload, cancellation of selection, and desktop preview/download use real bytes
Explicit replacement preserves the previous bytes; individual retirement retains the file
Unauthorized collaborators see no personal file names, metadata, counters or direct bytes
Explicit sharing is read only; preview closes after revocation and new direct calls fail
Mobile contact documents render without horizontal overflow and retain the same private catalogue
Cancellation during a real upload retains confirmed documents and permits explicit resumption
A concurrent catalogue addition yields a visible conflict and the same draft can be retried once
